images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset E05b: one NEW complete 16:9 cel-animation pose drawing, exact source n1290.
The single input is the ONLY authority for geometry, camera/crop, every head/eye/hand center, silhouette, limb angles, clothing/occlusion and background. Follow this exact source, not n1287 or any neighboring drawing. Fully redraw the complete scene as cool dark inked manga/cel artwork.
This pose restores the relative opposite body movements: foreground left Sukuna's guard sleeve and hands are LOWER and tilted from the earlier guard, while Gojo on the right leans forward with his attack arm extending behind the guard. Preserve source exact raised fist, broad diagonally sloping foreground sleeve, left profile and circular shoulder emblem. Preserve the lighter lower garment band/shape crossing the bottom where source shows it. Gojo's white hair, cyan eyes, head tilt, neck, black shirt, horizontal pale attack forearm and low other fist all stay at exact n1290 positions. Do not turn both characters as one rigid block; redraw their actual source-specific relative pose. Exactly source-visible arms/hands; no extra limbs or invented hidden anatomy.
Draw source’s cyan flame ignited around the attack hand in the upper middle, partly occluded by guard sleeve and cropped by the TOP edge. Same irregular filled turquoise shape, black-edged tongues, restrained glow, no white core, no invented horizontal projectile. Redraw the same blue city window grids and street perspective in source positions. No reframing, no extra headroom, no global downward offset.
Style: dark tapered contours and selective hatching, restrained cool gray-blue flat cel shadows, cold pale cream/gray skin and robe, deep black shirt, cyan eyes/effect accents. Coherent source dark/light mass design, avoid warm tan skin, glossy 3D, overly elaborate line texture or bright standalone illustration polish. Not a screenshot clean-up or a deformed previous drawing, but complete new reference-based artwork. No text whatsoever, including faint remnant letters; no logo, labels, signature or watermark.
